description: Source code implementing factory classes for OFDM modulators and demodulators, including pooling and specific configurations for PRACH demodulation, within a software radio system.

classes.name: ofdm_modulator_factory_generic
classes.description: Factory class for creating OFDM modulators with generic configuration.

classes.name: ofdm_modulator_pool_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating pooled OFDM modulators to support multithreading.

classes.name: ofdm_demodulator_pool_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating pooled OFDM demodulators to support multithreading.

classes.name: ofdm_demodulator_factory_generic
classes.description: Factory class for creating OFDM demodulators with generic configuration.

classes.name: ofdm_prach_demodulator_factory_sw
classes.description: Factory class for creating software-based PRACH demodulators with specific subcarrier spacing and sampling rate.

methods.name: create_ofdm_symbol_modulator
methods.description: Creates an OFDM symbol modulator with specified configuration.

methods.name: create_ofdm_slot_modulator
methods.description: Creates an OFDM slot modulator, wrapping a symbol modulator.

methods.name: create_ofdm_symbol_demodulator
methods.description: Creates an OFDM symbol demodulator with specified configuration.

methods.name: create_ofdm_slot_demodulator
methods.description: Creates an OFDM slot demodulator, wrapping a symbol demodulator.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of PRACH demodulator with specific subcarrier spacing and sampling rate.
